scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @flowdesk/shared build && pnpm --filter @flowdesk/config build && pnpm --filter @flowdesk/ui build && concurrently -k -n api,web,worker -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm --filter @flowdesk/api dev" "pnpm --filter @flowdesk/web dev" "pnpm --filter @flowdesk/api worker:dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @flowdesk/shared build && pnpm --filter @flowdesk/config build && pnpm --filter @flowdesk/ui build && pnpm --filter @flowdesk/api build && pnpm --filter @flowdesk/web build
scripts.quality: pnpm format && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.verify: pnpm format && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:integration && pnpm prisma:validate && pnpm build
